name: journalist-pi
description: A commodities-market journalist agent on the pi coding agent. Given a desk (biofuels or crude-oil) and an assignment, it gathers intel from the desk's primary sources, forms impressions (what moved, why it matters, what to watch), and authors a cited report into the workspace: a draft story, sources.json, verify.md, and PNG charts when numbers warrant. Every number is cited to a source URL; nothing is invented and nothing is published.

DESK.description: The desk this package reports for (biofuels or crude-oil) when the request does not name one in metadata.desk
